EN: Crew Seats: Here you will see a segment for each part in the vessel that has seats. You can assign kerbals to seats from the available crew, or remove kerbals from seats if you need an empty seat for a rescue.

Available Kerbals: The kerbals listed here are the ones on your roster. Pay special attention to the role and skill level of your kerbals, especially in career. If you run out you may need to hire more.
Astronaut Complex: This will take you to the AC where you can hire (or fire) members of your space program.
The crew tab in the construction interface helps you to assign kerbals to the seats in your vessel.
Vessel Crewing
Design Checklist: In the bottom half of the app will be the list of checks that may need your attention. You don't have to fix these, but it is always a good idea to give them a once over.
Basic Information: Here you will find things like part count, size and mass. In career mode you will see when you the hit the limits of your facilities.
This app can save you from disaster - if you're paying attention. The engineer's report lists things of note \nabout the vessel under construction.
